summary: Direct groups for Entra ID roles no longer fail at Commit.

fixes.title: Direct groups for Entra roles no longer fail
fixes.text: Creating a direct group now asks Role-assignable after you pick the permission groups. A group that reaches an Entra ID role is always role-assignable, so it no longer fails at Commit.

fixes.title: Status reports to Invardia arrive in full
fixes.text: A status detail that looked like a password made Invardia refuse some status fields for a day. That detail is no longer sent.
